name: Low-power current sensor relay interface
summary: Identifies the documented low-power current-sensor connection to its compatible relay input.
description: Identifies the documented low-power current-sensor connection to its compatible relay input. A current-transformer secondary arrangement carries a measuring current from a defined primary location to metering or protection inputs. Core identity, polarity and the connected circuit determine the measurement's meaning.

In a substation protection panel, separate CT cores can supply metering and protection circuits with different duties. A test boundary must preserve the secondary arrangement required by the selected CT and test device. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Low-power current signal” at the input and “Compatible measuring input” at the output. Conventional current inputs may be unsuitable.
